parsed.draft_response:
Thanks for flagging this—our team can help route your DPA clarification request to the appropriate privacy/legal contact. 

To ensure the right party reviews the correct materials, could you please share:
1) Which DPA document/version your legal team is reviewing (or paste the relevant section/questions).
2) Whether you’re asking for confirmations about (a) subprocessors, (b) data retention, and (c) support logs containing customer identifiers—please confirm if these are the only items.
3) The specific wording/requirements your legal team needs for each item (e.g., what “customer identifiers” means in this context).

Once we have the above, we’ll escalate internally to our privacy contact for review so you can proceed with enabling EU customer records.
promised_actions: Route/escalate the request to the appropriate privacy/legal contact for review
Ask for the minimum additional details needed to ensure the correct DPA materials and requirements are reviewed
safety_notes: Do not confirm subprocessors, retention periods, or log handling details without privacy/legal review.
Acknowledge escalation is required; do not promise a specific outcome, timeline, refund, or SLA.
